hypothesis_text: gridbot's registry continues the cs2agent experimental record (/home/ops/cs2agent/docs/experiments/registry.jsonl). All falsifications there remain binding here: confirmed-event-timing entries are CLOSED at every tested event scale (ADR-0029, ADR-0030) and are not re-run without a new mechanism claim. First open instrument to build: H-MODELENTRY1, exactly as pre-registered 2026-08-24T12:00Z in the cs2agent registry (REGISTERED_NO_RUN).

DATA-INTEGRITY FINDING (binding, not a strategy): 2,898/22,273 corpus rows (13.0%; 47.2% of bin-3) are post-round transition snapshots whose score_lead/rounds_played/man_advantage encode the labeled round's own outcome (verified twice independently, corpus-inference-v1 F1). BINDING FILTER for all training/backtests on training_rounds: drop rows failing rounds_played+1==round_number against BOTH features.round_number and top-level round_number. gridbot.corpus.build refuses such snapshots at build time from 2026-08-25. Every prior calibration number (incl. inherited Brier 0.1514) is suspect until recomputed under this filter. Full report: docs/experiments/2026-08-24-corpus-inference-v1.md

During a live unresolved CS2 round, when the map-score-trailing team holds a >=2-man alive advantage with >=20s on the clock, its true round-win probability is ~0.93 (corpus leak-filtered: 0.931, N=606, Wilson 0.908-0.948) while scoreboard-anchored books quote materially lower; buying the trailing side at ask<=0.85 in this state is +EV. Mechanism: man count is a near-sufficient statistic (ma>=+2 wins 0.950 at any score, N=1,680) vs score-implied 0.39-0.46; market flow anchors on scoreboard/match odds inside GRID's 13-27s lead. Predictive in-round state entry (H-MODELENTRY1 family), NOT the closed confirmed-flip lane. FALSIFIED on >=80 held-out state instances with live books if ANY of: (i) trailing-team resolution rate <0.85; (ii) <20% of instances ever show ask<=0.88 for the trailing side while the state holds; (iii) mean settled edge of ask<=0.85 paper entries <=+2 points. dry_run throughout. Data: GRID SS polls time-aligned with PM round-winner books, >=80 instances held-out. Full text: docs/experiments/2026-08-24-corpus-inference-v1.md

In regulation non-pistol rounds where exactly one team full-buys (loadout>=13400) at freeze-end, that team wins ~0.83 pooled (corpus 0.832, N=1,393, CI 0.811-0.851) - 0.849 at >=10k equip gap (N=1,234) but only 0.710 vs force-buys (N=155) - invariant to map scoreline (0.825 behind / 0.820 tied / 0.837 ahead); books quoting the buyer <0.78 in >=10k-gap states are systematically cheap. Persistent pre-round state mispricing spanning freeze+early round; graded by equip gap (dose-response frozen into the design), independent of the latency lead, not the closed lane. FALSIFIED on >=120 held-out mismatch rounds with books (>=60 at >=10k gap) if ANY of: (i) buyer resolution <0.79 pooled or <0.81 in >=10k bucket; (ii) <10% of mismatch rounds ever quote the buyer below 0.80; (iii) mean settled edge of qualifying paper entries <=+2 points after fees. If held-out force-buy subset shows buyer win <0.66, scope freezes to >=10k bucket only. Data: GRID freeze-end loadouts + time-aligned PM round books. Full text: docs/experiments/2026-08-24-corpus-inference-v1.md

The pistol-round winner wins the following round (2/14) at ~0.86 (corpus 0.859, 402/468, CI 0.825-0.888), rising to 0.874 (N=388) when the loser stays below full buy (89.2% of cases), falling to 0.702 (N=47) when the loser force/full-buys; round-2/14 books quoting the winner <0.80 before freeze-end are cheap and the loser's observable freeze-end buy is a binary trim trigger. Mechanism: broken loser economy (loser full-buys 10.8%, winner 92.2%; generic carryover elsewhere only 0.611, N=4,880) - economy, not momentum; edge window is the ~30-45s inter-round+freeze period; distinct mechanism from the closed confirmed-flip lane. FALSIFIED on >=100 held-out pistol->next-round pairs with books if ANY of: (i) pooled conversion <0.80; (ii) loser-buy conditional gap <5 points (corpus: 17); (iii) mean settled edge of ask<=0.80 paper entries <=+2 points, or no such quote appears in >=85% of pairs. Trim rule (~0.70-0.74 when loser full-buys) freezes with the hypothesis. Data: GRID rounds 1/13 winners + freeze-end loadouts rounds 2/14, time-aligned PM books, >=100 pairs. Full text: docs/experiments/2026-08-24-corpus-inference-v1.md

CELL PRE-REGISTRATION for H-MODELENTRY1 (frozen BEFORE any instance was recorded; amends nothing in the 2026-08-24T12:00Z registration, which stands verbatim incl. its stated prior that taker entry loses and only maker fills can clear, its confirmation bar, and its kill clause). SERVED MODEL (pinned): data/models/roundwin-v1 — LightGBM trimmed to best_iteration=96 + Platt sigmoid(0.96828*margin-0.12790), trained on the CORPUS-F1 leak-filtered corpus (19,326 rows), pinned temporal holdout of 32 series: Brier 0.1499 / ECE 0.0296 / AUC 0.864 (docs/MODEL.md). Artifact swap requires a new registry amendment. CELLS: entry side's calibrated win probability crossing UP through threshold in {0.65, 0.75, 0.85}, side in {ct, t} (t via 1-q symmetry), FIRST crossing only per (series, map, round, side, threshold). GUARDS: CORPUS-F1 coherence (scoreboard == resolved rounds AND current segment == labeled round), round unresolved, clock >= 10s. RECORDED per instance: q_prev, q, threshold, side, clock, matched Polymarket market (with match_score) and top-of-book for both outcome tokens at detection, grid_ts_ns. ACCOUNTING at verdict time (offline, from captured books): taker = cross spread at recorded ask; maker = post at recorded bid + tick with fill inferred from the subsequent captured stream; both cost-complete per the frozen bar. Implementation: gridbot.instruments.crossing (shadow engine, dry-run records only).

PRE-COMMITTED READING AMENDMENT for H-MANADV1 bar (i), frozen while ZERO instances have been recorded (verdict.json empty at amendment time — this changes how evidence will be read, before any evidence exists). Finding (managed deep-analysis 2026-08-25, verified three independent ways on the leak-filtered corpus): the 'trailing +2 men' resolution rate is strongly clock-dependent at fixed dose — 0.961 (20-45s clock) falling monotonically to 0.741 (>=90s); cluster-robust logit clock coefficient -0.0247/s (z=-4.79, p=1.7e-6); holds within every time-bin. First-qualifying-observation rates by bin: b0 0.800, b1 0.881, b2 0.955, b3 0.982. The frozen pooled bar (i) (<0.85 falsifies) is therefore decided by the engine's detection-clock mix, risking both false PASS and false FAIL. AMENDMENT: bar (i) will ALSO be read stratified by the instance's recorded clock_seconds in buckets [20,45), [45,75), [75,90), [90,inf). A pooled PASS while any bucket with N>=30 sits below 0.85 is PROVISIONAL, not confirmed; a pooled FAIL while every N>=30 bucket sits >=0.85 is likewise PROVISIONAL pending mix analysis. clock_seconds is already a frozen recorded field (H-MODELENTRY1-CELLS pattern), so this adds no new instrumentation. PROVENANCE ANNOTATION: the original 0.931/N=606 and 0.950/N=1,680 corpus anchors did not reproduce under 96 tested predicate/prefix variants (recomputed literal predicate: 0.941/N=1,311 rows, 1,009 rounds; all tested variants land 0.92-0.94, so the bar itself is not threatened) — the frozen anchors are treated as UNAUDITED until their exact predicate is recovered; the falsification bar stands unchanged. Full analysis: docs/analysis/managed/2026-08-25/analysis.md

VENUE BRIDGE (frozen before any instrument code exists; user signed off 2026-08-25). Polymarket US — the only executable venue for this account (intl CLOB is close-only for US) — lists esports_match_winner and esports_map_winner_N books but NO round books, so all four round-settling registrations are unquotable there. CLAIM: round-level state information inside GRID's 13-27s lead (calibrated roundwin-v1 q, live-monotone 0.80/0.86/0.93 across thresholds at n~500 crossings, plus the frozen event-lane anchors) propagates to map-winner fair value faster than PMUS map/match books re-anchor, because those books price at match granularity and update on scoreboard, not in-round state. FROZEN AGGREGATION (mapwin-race-v1, deterministic in (a,b,q)): with (a,b) = entry side's current map score and q = the instance's recorded round probability (MODELENTRY: model q; event lanes: recorded fair_value), P(map) = q*R(a+1,b) + (1-q)*R(a,b+1) where R is the race-to-13 win probability with future rounds iid at p_fut = (a+4)/(a+b+8) (Beta-smoothed team round share, prior 0.5 weight 8) and 12-12 overtime frozen at 0.5. DETECTION EVENTS: exactly the already-registered lanes' recorded instances (no new triggers); dedup as recorded. QUALIFYING ENTRY: the side's PMUS map_winner book for the LIVE map (match_winner only when the series is BO1), price <= P(map) - 0.04; execution maker-first at bid+tick under the standing caps; live clips $1-5, dry_run until PASS (rail 3 — arming is the user's act). FALSIFIED on >=150 held-out resolved instances carrying a PMUS book at detection if ANY of: (i) Brier(P_map) >= Brier(book price as forecast) on the same instances — the model must beat the venue's own price as a forecaster; (ii) ECE(P_map) > 0.08 (quintile bins); (iii) at >=60 qualifying entries, mean settled edge <= +2 points or by-series bootstrap 95% CI includes 0. STARVATION CLAUSE: if <5% of resolved instances ever show a qualifying quote, the lane closes as starved (the book-laziness claim failed in practice) absent new quote-availability evidence. Reporting layer: scripts/quant_eval.py (Brier/ECE/EV/Monte-Carlo/Brownian) reports progress; this bar is the only decision rule. Data: data/pmus/mappings-*.jsonl GRID<->PMUS join (22/88 matched 2026-08-25, all coverage 1.0), PMUS top-of-book attached at detection (engine wiring), map-winner oracle from the captured GRID stream.

Executor risk policy, frozen BEFORE the first armed session and before any live map-book data exists (first mapped matches 2026-08-26T09:00Z). Armed placements for H-MAPENTRY1 are restricted to 0.50 <= P_map <= 0.80. Engine-level gate, identical in dry_run and armed; gated rows are ledgered as status=skipped:band_gate and do NOT consume the one-entry-per-map-book dedup key (a later in-band crossing may enter). Missing P_map fails closed. MECHANISM CLAIM (diagnostic source: cs2agent ADR-0038, scored on gridbot's pinned 32-series temporally-forward holdout, 4,276 rows / 57 maps): the iid race future-round term p_fut=(a+4)/(a+b+8) ignores round correlation (economy snowball, side switch), producing symmetric over-dispersion — ECE(P_map) 0.137-0.145 vs the frozen 0.08 bar (CI [0.080,0.222]); score-only null R(a,b) reproduces the error, so q is exonerated (q at crossings transfers calibrated, +0.030 UNDER-confident at tau=0.85, CI excludes 0). Entry at P_map-0.04 measured settled edge: 0.50-0.70 +0.026, 0.70-0.80 +0.006, 0.80-0.90 -0.102, 0.90-0.95 -0.156, >=0.95 -0.076; pooled >=0.5 is -0.055..-0.064 with clustered CI excluding 0 at 2/3 thresholds; ~73% of qualifying crossings sit in the negative >=0.8 region. THE H-MAPENTRY1 BAR AND RECORDING POPULATION ARE UNCHANGED — the diagnostic is not a verdict input; live held-out capture still decides the lane. Gate lift requires BOTH: live in-band fill evidence consistent with the diagnostic, AND a pre-registered correlated-rounds aggregation (H-MAPENTRY2 candidate) beating mapwin-race-v1 head-to-head on held-out data. Clock-gating explicitly NOT adopted: ADR-0038 retracted its own ADR-0037 within-round warning for the crossing population (earliest-tercile calibration gaps -1.4/-1.1/+2.2 pts).

THE GATE IS HARM REDUCTION, NOT EDGE SELECTION; it stays as frozen. In-band clips buy fill-mechanics evidence, not demonstrated edge.
